definitions: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.
A conceptual structure or entity on which something draws or rests.
The main place where a person lives or works, or from which an organisation operates.
A substance capable of reacting with an acid to form a salt and water.
One of the four stations that must be reached in turn by a runner in baseball.
examples: The lamp has a heavy base.
The company's base is in London.
The chemical reacted with the base.
